rationale: The claim is declined under section 9 (General exclusions) of the wording, which says no benefit pays for "losses while you are breaking the law or impaired by alcohol or drugs". The dental clinic's own notes record heavy drinking through the evening of 20 June, that you smelled of alcohol and were unsteady on arrival, and a blackout from about 10 pm to 9 am, so the tooth was lost while you were impaired by alcohol. The treatment would otherwise have been payable under section 7 (Emergency Medical) for $1,350 less the $50 Premium deductible, and the itemised invoice and medical records required by section 7 are both on file.
